soundness_flags.label: ass:twin-faithfulness
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Dai model uses a pooled observed/interventional law over X and ζ, whereas a single regime law contains no ζ and therefore cannot be faithful to the corresponding twin graph/MAG on U_k; retag and replace this with the correctly conditioned pooled-law faithfulness assumption.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace ass:twin-faithfulness with faithfulness of each correctly conditioned pooled binary-indicator law on X∪{ζ_k} to its latent-projection MAG, and cite the precise pooled-law construction in Dai Definition 1/Theorem 1.

Develop the selection-lifting handle into an explicit candidate finite rule list and a worked nontrivial common-basal witness pair that preserves indicator-involving colliders; this makes the central construction more falsifiable before proof work begins.

Demote observational-fiber refinement to a corollary unless it is strengthened with a natural strict-subfiber example or a checkable endpoint-richness criterion not obtained merely by enumerating the restricted fiber.
